requirements.text: Phase A: RBAC shadow-mode disclosure -- UI must never present unenforced permission changes as effectively enforced
nonRequirements: No change to actual RBAC authority mode unless repository evidence proves that is intended

acceptanceCriteria.text: Backend exposes real RBAC_PERSISTED_AUTHORITY mode via GET /rbac/authority-mode; frontend Papéis e Permissões UI discloses non-enforced state; enforced state (production/staging, RBAC_PERSISTED_AUTHORITY=ON) shows no banner

requirements.text: Phase A: marketing fabricated KPIs must be classified and never presented as measured performance without qualification

acceptanceCriteria.text: campaign.metrics carries isEstimated end-to-end (write at creation, read on fetch); Campanhas.tsx discloses estimated status in the KPI strip caption and per-campaign detail view instead of presenting fabricated numbers as measured; full web typecheck and marketing-module suite pass

requirements.text: Phase A: decorative admin/settings controls must not claim success without a durable mutation
nonRequirements: No invented backend contract where none exists

acceptanceCriteria.text: AdminSettings.tsx's SaveBar (used by Geral/Email/Seguranca/Notificacoes tabs) no longer claims success without a durable mutation -- disabled with honest copy instead of a fake success toast; full web typecheck and admin-module suite pass

requirements.text: Phase A: workspace module stub tabs/routes must be classified and misleading navigation/fake metrics corrected where safely provable
nonRequirements: No new product modules built without spec

acceptanceCriteria.text: Workspace module: overview tab route unaffected; the 5 undestined tabs (releases/campaigns/financial/team/activity) render an honest placeholder instead of a blank Outlet; ArtistOverview's hardcoded fake counts (8/3) replaced with honest Indisponivel; full web typecheck and new router-integration test pass

requirements.text: Phase B: forensically classify and consolidate all 60 protected preexisting dirty paths into functional clusters with proven dispositions
nonRequirements: No git reset/clean/add-all; no force push; no discarding unknown hunks

findings.summary: CODEBASE_MAP Gotcha #17: the fully backend-wired 'Papeis e Permissoes' granular permission editor gave zero indication that RBAC_PERSISTED_AUTHORITY can be SHADOW (observe-only). Evidence gathered this pass: .env.production and .env.staging both explicitly set RBAC_PERSISTED_AUTHORITY=ON (enforcement IS live in real deployed environments); only unset/local-dev environments default to the code-level SHADOW fallback. No API endpoint previously exposed this mode to the frontend at all.
findings.justification: Fixed: new GET /rbac/authority-mode (read-only, RequireRole owner/admin, matches route-level guard already on the whole controller) exposes {mode, enforced}; useRoles() fetches it; Configuracoes.tsx renders a disclosure banner in the Papeis e Permissoes card only when enforced=false. Did NOT change the actual authority mode. Backend unit tests (6) + frontend guard test (3) + both apps' typecheck pass.

findings.summary: CODEBASE_MAP Gotcha #16: estimateCampaignResults() (budget*constant) is persisted into campaign.metrics and rendered as unqualified real KPIs (Cliques/Impressoes/Conversoes/CTR) once a campaign is saved -- publish() never actually calls any ad-platform integration for any provider, so this is 100% of campaigns today, not an edge case.
findings.justification: Fixed: MetricSnapshot.isEstimated threaded end-to-end (write in campaign-builder.helpers.ts, read in marketing.service.ts's campaignFromApi, absent-defaults-to-true for pre-existing campaigns). Campanhas.tsx's KPI strip caption and campaign detail view now disclose estimated status instead of presenting fabricated numbers as measured. central-analitica.data.ts/Metricas.tsx's separate aggregation surface, which also reads campaign.metrics, is NOT yet updated to consume the new flag -- deferred as its own finding since it mixes campaign ad-metrics with genuinely real streaming/artist analytics and needs careful tracing to avoid mislabeling real data.

findings.summary: buildCentralAnaliticaModel aggregates campaign.metrics (reach/impressions/clicks/conversions) into executiveKpis/breakdown rows labeled 'Alcance total'/'Impressoes'/'Cliques' without consuming the isEstimated flag added this pass -- same disclosure gap as Campanhas.tsx, not yet fixed here because this surface mixes fabricated campaign ad-metrics with genuinely real streaming/artist data (its own doc comment: 'Metrics not supplied by a live integration remain explicitly unavailable') and needs careful tracing to avoid mislabeling real data as estimated.
findings.justification: Deferred: real fix requires tracing which fields in buildCentralAnaliticaModel are campaign-ad-metrics-derived (now labelable via isEstimated) vs genuinely real streaming/artist data, to avoid mislabeling real data. The isEstimated flag added this pass makes that follow-up tractable.

findings.summary: CODEBASE_MAP Gotcha #19: Geral/Email/Seguranca/Notificacoes tabs' inputs are uncontrolled (defaultValue only, no onChange -- React never sees edits) and the shared SaveBar button fired toast.success('Configuracoes salvas') unconditionally, with zero API call and no state even read. No backend contract exists for platform-wide settings (name/URL/timezone/SMTP/trial days/etc.).
findings.justification: Fixed: SaveBar's Save button is now disabled with an explicit 'esta secao ainda nao persiste alteracoes' note and a tooltip explaining why, instead of a lying success toast. Did not invent a platform-settings backend (no contract exists; that's a real feature needing product spec). 3 new render-based tests (real AdminSettings component, real click) prove the button is disabled and fires neither toast.success nor an API call; full admin-module suite (4 files, 18 tests) and web typecheck pass.

findings.summary: TabWebhooks ('Novo Webhook', 'Rotacionar') and TabChavesApi ('Nova Chave API') buttons have no onClick handler at all -- inert rather than lying (API_KEYS is honestly hardcoded empty with a code comment explaining why), a different and lower-severity class of defect than the SaveBar false-success toast fixed this pass. Not fixed here.
findings.justification: Lower severity than the false-success SaveBar pattern (inert, not deceptive) and needs a real webhooks/API-keys backend contract to wire up -- a feature, not a truthfulness fix. Deferred.

findings.summary: CODEBASE_MAP Gotcha #26: the workspace module is largely a stub -- only 1 of 6 nav tabs (overview) had a registered route (the other 5 -- releases/campaigns/financial/team/activity -- fell through to nothing), and the one implemented tab (ArtistOverview) hardcoded fake metrics (Lancamentos: 8, Campanhas: 3 as literal JSX numbers, no data source). The route itself is currently unreachable from any nav link in the app (not linked anywhere), lowering current user-facing risk.
findings.justification: Fixed the truthfulness gaps without building the missing feature: (1) added a wildcard child route rendering an honest 'Em construcao' placeholder (EmptyState) for the 5 undestined tabs instead of a blank Outlet; (2) replaced ArtistOverview's hardcoded fake Lancamentos/Campanhas counts with honest Indisponivel, matching the codebase's established AdminDashboard pattern for unavailable KPIs -- no new releases/campaigns-count query was invented. Did not build the 5 missing tab pages (needs product spec) or link the module into app navigation (out of scope -- it's currently unreachable, which is why this stayed MEDIUM not HIGH severity). 6 new tests (real router-integration render, not just source-grep) cover overview-still-works plus all 5 placeholder paths; full web typecheck passes.
